xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnComposition:
(1) Mr. Rajiv Lochan Jain (DIN: 00161022) has completed his second consecutive term as a Non-Executive Independent Director of the Company with effect from the close of business hours on December 31, 2025.
Also, we would like to inform you that Mr. Rajiv Lochan Jain was re-appointed as an Independent Non-Executive Director of the Company for a second consecutive term with effect from March 12, 2023, up to December 31, 2025, pursuant to the Postal Ballot Notice dated February 14, 2023, which was duly approved by the shareholders of the Company with the requisite majority on March 24, 2023.
Further, please note that the Date of Birth of Mr. Rajiv Lochan Jain is January 01, 1951. Accordingly, he will attain the age of 75 years on January 01, 2026, whereas his current term as Independent Director in the Company was completed on December 31, 2025.
In view of the above, as per Regulation 17(1A) of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, no non-executive director who has attained the age of 75 years can continue as a director unless a special resolution is passed to that effect. In the present case, since Mr. Jains tenure was completed prior to attaining the age of 75 years, the Company has complied with all applicable statutory requirements in relation to his appointment
(2) Ms. Varsha Chaudhary Jain (DIN: 08388940) has resigned from the position of Whole Time Director of the Company with effect from the close of business hours of December 31, 2025.
